jobs.title: Sr. BI Analyst
jobs.description:
Edgewell is a global team of over 6,000 visionaries, doers and makers. Our secret is people, and we have an inspiring and collaborative global force of them. Our portfolio of over 25 brands touches lives in more than 50 countries by making useful things joyful. Together, we reimagine good mornings and endless summers, strive for more sustainable ways to beautify and bond, and do it all with not only confidence but determination.
Position Summary

The Business Intelligence Coordinator will be responsible for analyzing and providing strategic insights to support decision-making within the Distributor Cluster including Puerto Rico.

- Key relationships internally will include Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply, HR and Distributor contacts.

- Supports business reviews and provides analysis upon request.

- Participates in forecasting, pricing, incentives and reporting processes.

Universal Accountabilities

- Act in a manner that aligns with The Company’s business goals, objectives, values and code of conduct

- Understand and operate in accordance with Company policies and procedures

- Reporting & Analysis : Develop and maintain regular ad-hoc reports on key performance indicators (KPIs) such as sales, inventory, and customer metrics.

- Strategic Decision Support: Provide strategic analysis and recommendations to support decision-making

- Business Insights : Provide actionable insights to support strategic decision-making, such as market expansion, product offerings, sales strategies or business trends

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a liaison between business units (sales, mkt, finance, etc.) to ensure their data needs are met.

- Optimization Recommendations : Identify and develop opportunities to improve process and system efficiency and effectiveness, based on BI insights to drive performance improvement.

- Continuous Improvement and Innovation: Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging technologies in business intelligence

Specific Accountabilities

- Data Management and Integration : Gather and consolidate data from various sources (sales, inventory, financial systems, etc.) across the distributor cluster to ensure all relevant information is centralized. (e.g. Sell In with all necessary details: Vol, NIS, DFF, NCS; and integrate Sell Out of Strategic markets/Accounts).

- BI Tool Management . Coordinate with relevant teams to manage the setup, configuration, and ongoing maintenance of BI tools (such as Power BI, Tableau, or other analytics platforms)

- Data Visualization and Dashboards : Create and maintain interactive dashboards for different stakeholders within the distributor cluster, including senior management, sales teams, and operational staff. Present data in a visually appealing and easily understandable format to help decision-makers quickly grasp key insights.

- Training and Support : Provide training to internal teams on how to interpret BI reports and use BI tools effectively

- Forecasting : Work on forecasting models that help predict future trends in sales, inventory, or market demand based on historical data.

- Actively participate in EBP focus on commercial meetings and provide inputs in other key meetings like: Monthly Locks (FAST) and full ownership in the SLOBs process

- Pricing Process: Supporting Cluster Pricing analysis and Price setup

- Incentives : Management of incentive programs for sales forces and merchandisers, including calculation and payment

Required Skills and Experience

- Market Analysis and Strategic Thinking: Ability to assess market trends, key players, consumer behaviors, identify opportunities, and develop data-driven strategies

- Financial Acumen: Ability to evaluate the financial viability of business opportunities.

- Problem Solving and Innovation: Ability to think creatively to overcome challenges and propose innovative solutions

- Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Economics, Statistics, or related field

- Proven Track Record: Minimum 2 years of experience in business intelligence or data analysis

- Industry Knowledge: Experience in industries relevant to the Company (FMCG / Personal Care).

- Advanced knowledge of data analysis tools such as Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, etc.

- Effective communication and presentation skills

- Adaptability: Ability to work in a dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities

- Leadership and Collaboration: Experience working in cross-functional and multicultural teams. Ability to lead regional initiatives and influence stakeholders at all levels.

- Language Proficiency: Fluency in English and Spanish (written and spoken)

- Preferences/Optional: Knowledge of customer relationship management (CRM) tools, Certification in business intelligence or data analysis

Working Relationships

- Reports directly to LATAM Distributor Cluster Director

- Key relationships internally will include Sales, HR, MKT, Supply and Finance

Work Environment

- Ability to lead processes / projects virtually

- Understanding of multicultural differences across the markets in the region being respectful and careful with the way of communicating and interacting with the local teams and with Corporate

- The position will be based in the Edgewell COL City offices

- Work schedule: Hybrid Model 3 times at office from 8:00am – 5:00PM

Responsible for the LATAM legal entities, working with external Banking Services providers, local affiliate and GBS AR/AP teams, the Corporate Treasury group and Outsourcing partners, ensure that all LATAM Personal Care legal entities are provided with appropriate Treasury support, in accordance with business strategy and corporate policies and procedures.

Accountabilities

- Banking Administration- transactional support.

- Cashflow forecast analysis.

- Requires analytical and numerical skills to involve treasury management reporting.

- The control of outsources in terms of accounting, tax, including compliance with deadlines for payment taxes and payment payroll.

- Reconciliation of cash and intercompany accounts.

- Managing foreign currency exposure and foreign currency payments.

- Managing expenses platform and corporate credit cards.

- Involved in the accounting closing activities by reviewing JE and performing account analysis.

Experience required

- Experience in treasury operations or in an accounting role with banking and cash accounting focus.

- Certified Public Accountant (or local equivalent), or extensive relevant experience.

- Graduate degree with an emphasis on Finance, Accounting and Management (preferred)

- English Level  B2 or higher

- Proficiency in Excel

- ERP SAP

Skills

- A good level of numeracy and experience performing quantitative and qualitative analysis.

- Solid accounting and book-keeping knowledge.

- Organized, structured, logical, and systematic in their approach.

- Focused on delivering to internal and external deadlines.

- Good interpersonal skills to establish excellent working relationship with a wide variety of people at all levels.

- Flexible and adaptable to change in accordance with business needs.

- Good team player, comfortable working as part of a matrix environment
